description: Annual Lives Lost on NT Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Road Safety Data. Annual statistics of lives lost on NT roads based on road user type as at December each year. Shows breakdown of demographics of individuals and whether lives were lost on urban or regional roads. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Road Safety Data. Its tags are Crash, Fatality, Injury, Intrastate, NT. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-05-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
